headline: Adopted revised Protect Act, wellness, and medication policies; approved school field trips and payment warrants.
summary: Three revised policies were adopted, each by a unanimous vote. Students reported on bylaws, recruitment, and grading, and the superintendent presented a 2026–2029 strategic plan, with a vote expected at a later meeting. Savings from school mergers and moves include $1.4M in salary savings and $332,000 in lease costs.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda, including field trips and the September 8, 2026 minutes, by unanimous vote.
Approved FY26 and FY27 warrants, including $742,435.14 and $427,081.52.
Adopted revised Policy 1408, the Protect Act Policy, by unanimous vote.
Adopted revised Policy 5711 ADF, the Wellness Policy, on its third reading by unanimous vote.
Adopted revised Policy 5709, the Medication Administration Policy, on its third reading by unanimous vote.

decision_evidence.quote: Approval of Consent Agenda A motion was made by Member Hoffman and seconded by Member Stott to approve the agenda as presented. ... Outcome: Motion passed unanimously.
Motion for Adoption: Member Stott moved (seconded by Member Hoffman) to adopt the revised Policy 1408 (Protect Act). Motion carried unanimously.
Motion to adopt Policy 5711 ADF for its third reading moved by Member Cornell, seconded by Member Miranda. Motion carried unanimously.
Motion to adopt Policy 5709 for its third reading by Member Cornell, seconded by Member Scott. Motion carried unanimously.
